hero.headline: Your ticket, ready
hero.support: Discover events, reserve your spot, and show up with everything sorted. No lines, no guesswork — direct access in your hand.
hero.imageAlt: Modern venue steps at night lit with warm spotlights

about.headline: Clear events. Tickets without the fuss.
about.body: {appNameDisplay} brings venues and audiences together in one experience: real dates, understandable tickets, and a clean interface so you can decide with absolute confidence. No fine print, no surprises at the door.
about.imageAlt: Hands holding a phone with a digital ticket QR at a venue entrance

how.headline: Three steps. No noise.
how.support: We cut endless forms so you go from discovery to access in minutes, with just the right information at each step.

1.title: Create your account
1.body: Register once with the essentials. After that, every event is one tap away — no starting over or repeating details.

2.title: Pick the event
2.body: Browse dates, venues, and tickets with what matters: clear pricing, real availability, and the context you need to decide without noise.

3.title: Ticket ready
3.body: Buy, confirm, and carry your digital pass on your phone. Arrive knowing your place is already set.

clarity.headline: Ticket, door, and schedule — no fine print.
clarity.support: What you need to decide and arrive, up front.

ticket.title: Clear tickets
ticket.body: Type, price, and availability in one place. No surprises in line.

secure.title: QR ready at the door
secure.body: Clear confirmation and a code ready when you arrive. Less friction at entry.

time.title: Dates you can scan fast
time.body: Times and venues in view — while there’s still room.

events.headline: The schedule isn’t open yet
events.support: When events go live, they’ll live here. Create your account so you’re ready the day the first date drops.
events.supportLive: A few dates to start. Open any one or browse the full list.
events.error: We couldn’t load the schedule right now.

closing.headline: Your next event starts here.
closing.support: Create your account and come back when the full schedule opens. No noise — ready for the night.

organizers.headline: Publish venues, events, and tickets.
organizers.support: The {appNameDisplay} panel is for owners and staff: create venues, build the schedule, and sell tickets without the noise.

footer.tagline: Clear events. Tickets ready before the door.
footer.publishBody: Manage venues, events, and tickets from the panel.
footer.madeFor: Made so you can enjoy every event with clarity and peace of mind.

signOutDialog.title: Sign out
signOutDialog.description: Do you want to leave? You'll need to sign in again to come back.
